text: When a family calls about their online request, it helps to know exactly what they saw.
Signed-in families start with their details filled in.
The one thing to remember: the form only offers times routing would offer.
They confirm where the visit is.
They pick the pet and tell us why.
If routing has times that fit, they pick a doctor, a day and a time. It books straight away and shows up in Auto-Booked.
Otherwise they tell us what works, and a CL calls them.
They see this, with an offer to look at membership.

They also get an email: We Received Your Appointment Request. If the time they picked was taken while they were on the page, Scout doesn't book it. It tells them our team will call soon to find another time.

The most common mistakes: telling a family their online request is booked when it's still in New, and not knowing that a picked time can be taken while they're on the page. Remember: the form only offers times routing would offer. If none suit, the family asks for a call, and that request comes to us.
